outcome: diagnosis of prolonged premature rupture of membranes (PROM)
cohort: The study included 99 women with suspected prolonged premature rupture of membranes (PROM) and a pregnancy duration of more than 24 weeks, from six tertiary institutions in southern Nigeria.
finding: AmnioQuick Duo+ was found to be non-inferior and comparable in accuracy to the PAMG-1 test for the diagnosis of PROM, with a diagnostic discordance rate of 3.1%.
